Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!
If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul…
Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.
Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”
“Does our law judge a man, unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”
But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”
He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will…
and Saul threw the spear, for he said, “I will pin David to the wall!” David escaped from his presence twice.
Saul sought to pin David to the wall with the spear; but he slipped away out of Saul’s presence, and he stuck the spear…
Saul sent messengers to David’s house, to watch him, and to kill him in the morning. Michal, David’s wife, told him…
Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man, and don’t associate with one who harbors anger:
This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all: yes also, the heart of the sons of…
The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?
If he says, ‘It is well,’ your servant shall have peace; but if he is angry, then know that evil is determined by him.
Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said to him, “Why should he be put to death? What has he done?”
translations.bsb: “Why must he be put to death?” Jonathan replied. “What has he done?”
translations.kjv: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?
translations.asv: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore should he be put to death? what hath he done?
